attempts.note: Internal test adaptor (package description "Internal use only"); src/Adaptor.js defines only version() and re-exports combine, fn, log. It makes no network calls, so there is no external spec to find.

notes: testing (1.0.10) is a monorepo test fixture with no external system. ast.json lists no operations (version() carries no @public tag); the source defines version() and re-exports combine, fn and log from common. "Full" is that surface: version() is modelled as POST /version (state in, {...state, version} out) and the three re-exports are enumerated in info.x-openfn-local-operations. The July stub's httpbin-style /get, /post and /status/{code} endpoints were invented (nothing in the adaptor calls them) and are removed, as are its facades for the common re-exports.
